chrome.* APIs

Google Chrome provides APIs such as chrome.bookmarks and chrome.tab so that extensions can interact with the browser. Here are the supported chrome.* APIs:

  • bookmarks
  • extension
  • pageActions
  • self
  • tabs
  • toolstrip
  • windows
